name: Fractal Brownian Motion (fBm) with Perlin Noise
aliases: Fractal Brownian Motion (FBM) for Volume Noise
definition: A technique to generate rougher, more natural-looking noise by summing multiple octaves of base noise with increasing frequency and decreasing amplitude.
summary: Fractal Brownian Motion with Perlin Noise generates natural-looking volumetric structures by summing multiple octaves of noise with increasing frequency and decreasing amplitude, providing multi-scale detail that standard Perlin noise lacks.
